title: Bergstrom Airport Conversion Explored
summary:
*   Austin city leaders convened a special meeting to discuss the future of air travel and airport infrastructure.
*   The primary focus was a detailed presentation on aviation demand forecasts for the potential conversion of Bergstrom Air Force Base into a commercial air carrier airport.
*   This meeting marked a significant step in the city's evaluation of developing a new major airport to meet future travel needs.
